# FLX-5022: virtual clock or scheduler input outside its declared domain

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

The virtual clock carries integer milliseconds from a declared RFC 3339 start in UTC (KERNEL-SPEC §7). A timestamp without an offset, with sub-millisecond precision the clock cannot represent, a tick of zero or fewer milliseconds, time bounds that end before they start, or an item scheduled outside those bounds are all refused: a run whose clock is not the declared clock cannot be replayed against the plan that declared it.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5022
```
